text: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed the CopilotKit packages, created the API route, and updated the layout and page files exactly as the quickstart specifies. TypeScript compilation passes cleanly (`npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0 with no errors), and the dev server starts and binds to port 3000 (confirmed via `ss -tlnp`). However, the server hangs indefinitely on `○ Compiling / ...` and never responds to HTTP requests—curl times out after 10 seconds with 0 bytes received. I had to deviate from the docs by using `openai:gpt-4o-mini` instead of the documented `openai:gpt-5.4-mini` (which does not exist), and no real OpenAI API key was present in the sandbox environment so a placeholder was used. The core blocker is the Next.js dev server failing to finish compilation, preventing the app from ever serving traffic.
